keep_policy: Keep any seven-card sample with at least two lands, starting with the original seven. Same policy in OTP/OTD. The floor of four remains a methodological proposal.
bottom_policy: After m mulligans keep 7-m cards. Aim for 3 lands at hand sizes 5–6, or 2 at size 4, constrained by the cards available. Among retained lands prefer untapped lands; bottom the rest. No bottoming before a mulligan-free keep.

part_1.description: Ideal untapped-land control to isolate 19 vs 20. Not a proposed Affinity composition.

scope: Exact probabilities plus a Monte Carlo validation pilot. No card colors or individual land names.
Only natural draws, one land play per turn and entering tapped. Nonlands are inert markers: no scry, extra draws, spells, affinity or hate.
Part 1 isolates land quantity. Part 2 reports both 19 and 20 to avoid losing their interaction before a provisional choice.
Capacity means available mana after the land play and before spells; it is not mana actually spent or wasted.
Failing the mulligan floor is retained in unconditional denominators; screw among kept hands has a separate denominator.
With color fixing and resilience excluded, fewer tapped lands have no compensating modeled benefit. This study quantifies the speed cost; it cannot identify the best overall bridge count.
A final deck recommendation needs the subsequent composition and spell-engine stage. Recheck provisional 19/20 and bridge choices there.
